_readme: Display labels for enum tokens of the tech-fit-estimation method (English deliverables). Keys with '_' are UI texts. Token_ctx keys: '_appr' = the approach of an option (the bare token 'standard' is the reviewer name on the Claims sheet), '_blk' = block on the Surcharges_and_Phases sheet, '_start' = the starting point of an option.
_dev_derivation: sum of the {estimation.size_term.en} sizes of all requirements of this option (sheet Estimation, positions summed)
_surcharge_derivation: rate from the Parameters sheet on the development of this option
_dev_derivation_scenario: Sum of the {estimation.size_term.en} sizes of this scenario's row classes (sheet Estimation, positions summed)
_saving_title: Saving: migration effort the refactoring makes unnecessary
_saving_derivation: Sum of the savings of this option's refactoring rows (sheet Estimation, column Saving), subtracted from the development
_is_dev_derivation: Sum of the {estimation.integration_platform} sizes of this scenario's row classes (sheet Estimation, positions summed)
_is_surcharge_derivation: Rate of the Parameters sheet on this scenario's {estimation.integration_platform} development
route-external_arch: to a system outside this estimate
_dev_derivation_ext: Sum of this system's inputs on sheet Estimation
_dev_derivation_system: Sum of this option's work packages on sheet Estimation (positions summed)
_surcharge_derivation_system: Rate from sheet Parameters on the development of this option
_surcharge_derivation_total: Rate from sheet Parameters on the development of every system of this scenario
